SELECT 
  step1.zoneref,
  step1.entrystat,
  step1.avg_traitcount,
  step1.record_count,
  CAST(step1.record_count AS REAL) / step2.total_count AS ratio
FROM (
  SELECT 
    sf.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489
  GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat
) step1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM scanfeatures sf
    JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489
    GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat
  )
) step2
WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
